feeds.title: The Autism Dad Blog
feeds.description: The real-life story of a family coping not only with autism but multiple, serious physical and emotional health issues. Rob Gorski writes about his life as a single Dad raising 3 autistic kids.

feeds.title: Hi Blog! I'm Dad.
feeds.description: I'm James Guttman, father of two children. One six year old (non verbal) and one nine year old (nonstop verbal). My mission is to share stories about his family, understanding autism, life after a quintuple bypass at 35, and overall topics that he feels might resonate with others.

feeds.title: The Additional Needs Blogfather
feeds.description: Find articles on autism, dealing with it as a parent, tips for managing and making your autistic child happy and more! Mark Arnold (The Additional Needs Blogfather) is the Additional Needs Ministry Director for Urban Saints' pioneering additional needs ministry, including training, consultancy, conference speaking and resourcing.

feeds.title: Kelvin's Musings
feeds.description: A Stay-Home-Dad's Raw and Unfinished Journey with Autism, Parenting, Writing & Life. I'm Kelvin from sunny Singapore where I live with my lovely wife and two boys, born 2009 and 2011.

feeds.title: The Dads' Fire Circle Blog
feeds.description: A place for Dads of children with additional needs to gather and journey together. Mark Arnold (The Additional Needs Blogfather) is the Additional Needs Ministry Director for Urban Saints'. Father to James who is Autistic and has associated Learning Difficulties, Epilepsy and Anxiety Disorder.

feeds.title: Autism Dadvocate Blog
feeds.description: This blog is here to discuss the experiences and challenges of being a parent of a child with autism. This is a group for parents of autistic kids to share their stories and learn from each other. Autismdadvocate.org is an online support forum for dads with children with autism and about the commonalities we all face as fathers.

feeds.title: Stories About Autism
feeds.description: Stories about everyday life raising two boys with autism. Written from a dad's point of view.

feeds.title: My Son Isaac
feeds.description: Matt Davis blogs about his fourteen year old son Isaac who was diagnosed with autism just after his third birthday.

feeds.title: Parenting Autism in Adelaide
feeds.description: Hi! I am Ryan, a 37-year-old dad of 2 from Adelaide Australia, my son is 5 with non-verbal Autism and Global Delay. My blog is about him, and parenthood in general. This blog is about the journey that is not just about being a father to an Autistic child.
